name: research-router
description: An intelligent research-routing MCP server that automatically selects the appropriate SerpApi engine for natural-language research queries.
long_description: ResearchRouter provides one intelligent research tool that automatically detects whether a query is about general web research, news, academic papers, jobs, shopping, or places, then routes the query to the appropriate SerpApi engine.
